regime_rules.probabilities: forward filtering under each row's origin-time fitted model
regime_rules.covariance_floor: enforced after every diagonal maximum-likelihood M step
regime_rules.reconstruction: restore frozen validation probabilities; append later origin-time fits

feature_rules.excess_compounding: product(1 + weekly asset return - weekly BIL return) - 1

tie_break: lowest candidate ID in the declared Cartesian grid order

selection_metrics.return_model: lowest pooled walk-forward mean squared error
selection_metrics.allocation: highest annualized validation excess-return Sharpe ratio

allocation_objective: mu @ w - risk_aversion / 2 * w @ covariance_4w @ w - turnover_penalty * norm1(w - w_previous)
allocation_reference: holdings drifted to the Friday cutoff

benchmarks.projection: Euclidean projection onto the strategy weight constraints

accounting.execution: Monday close, or next trading close on a market holiday

input_provenance.availability_policy: next local midnight after the ALFRED vintage date

hmm_fit_attempts.failure: ValueError: Transition rows must sum to one.

fit_strategy: five within-origin max_iter checkpoint fit calls per parameter group; every grid candidate evaluated
seal_format: sha256 of canonical JSON excluding the seal field
